2026_02_SEA_ARI.headline: Drew Lock takes the controls against an Arizona team carrying Week 1 confidence
2026_02_SEA_ARI.paragraph1: Seattle will start Drew Lock with Sam Darnold out because of a glute injury, and the Seahawks also enter Sunday with safety Ty Okada unavailable. Arizona is 1-0 after beating the Chargers and now gets its home opener, but cornerback Garrett Williams is out and several other defenders are questionable. Seattle needs Lock to stay on schedule rather than invite long-yardage pressure; the Cardinals can test him by disguising coverage while protecting against Seattle’s physical run game.
2026_02_SEA_ARI.model_rationale: Lock’s decision-making against Arizona’s changing coverage structure, together with the Cardinals’ ability to hold up in a depleted secondary, should govern Seattle’s passing efficiency.
